facts.quoteOnly: A sit-down steakhouse: these are their published menu prices, so nothing is ordered here. Book a table on their site or call.
facts.menuNote: Prices from the menus on their own website; drinks and wine are not listed here.
facts.siteNote: Brunch is Saturday and Sunday 11:30am–2:30pm; happy hour Monday to Friday 4–6pm, not holidays. No valet: metered street parking, Hills Plaza Garage on Folsom, or SpotHero. Corkage is $35 a bottle (four at most) and cake is $5 a guest. Their sister restaurant Waterbar is next door.

glenn: 27 Oct 5:55 pm: screenshots of their site, 'https://www.epicsteak.com/', 'San Francisco • Eats / BEASTY • Steakhouse'
flags: 81 items from their website menus (Dinner, Brunch, Happy Hour, Dessert, Kids); cocktails, beer, wine and dessert wines left out (age check), and brunch repeats of dinner dishes (raw bar, salads, steaks, sides) not listed twice. About the 80 cap.
Their oyster order ($24 / $46) and Maine lobster add-on ($46 / $94) each show two prices with no size given; labelled 'smaller'/'larger' only.
Steak Frites includes a glass of Hamel Cabernet Sauvignon in their description; kept as a dish.

Email: the visible text on their site says reservations@epicsteak.com, but the header/footer email icons link to reservations@epicroasthouse.com (their former name, Epic Roasthouse). The visible epicsteak.com address is used.

Hours agree on their site, its structured data and Yelp (Yelp's snapshot omits Sunday). OpenTable splits Sat/Sun into brunch 11:30am–2:30pm and dinner from 2:30pm, and also lists Friday dinner from 2:30pm where their site says 4pm.
OpenTable labels (415) 369-9955 as the private events coordinator's line; their own site uses it as the main number.
Menu still carries summer wording (summer ratatouille, summer truffles) beside fall dishes; spelling fixed only for 'ailoi' (aioli) and 'gastric' (gastrique), names otherwise kept, title-cased.
Brunch 'Hand Cut Beef Tartare' ($24, potato gaufrettes) and brunch-only Veuve Clicquot bottle ($60) not listed separately.
Instagram handle taken from their site's link; the profile itself was not opened.
